bugs.error_message: A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML didn't match the client properties; iframe srcdoc stayed empty
bugs.root_cause: srcdoc computed from window.location.origin during render: server rendered '' and client rendered the real string, React refused to patch the mismatch
bugs.fix: Resolve origin in useEffect into state; render empty srcdoc on the server and first client pass

bugs.error_message: GET /_blob/<id> and /_files/... returned 404 from the Next not-found page
bugs.root_cause: App Router ignores folders starting with `_` (private folders)
bugs.fix: Moved to src/app/blob and src/app/files and added rewrites for /_blob and /_files in next.config.ts

bugs.error_message: ReferenceError: window is not defined at ShareDialog
bugs.root_cause: Client component read window.location during SSR render

bugs.error_message: TypeError: Invalid URL input '/api/v1/emails' from Better Auth magic-link on production
bugs.root_cause: Coolify passes every compose env var, so SENDSPRITE_URL arrived as an empty string; the sendsprite SDK reads that env itself and used '' as baseUrl

bugs.error_message: Hash links (href="#id") inside a published artifact load the host page (or /_files/<id>/) into the frame instead of scrolling
bugs.root_cause: The viewer renders pages via a sandboxed srcdoc iframe; about:srcdoc documents resolve relative URLs against the host page URL (or the injected <base>), so '#id' becomes https://host/a/slug#id, a cross-document navigation
bugs.fix: Runtime registers a window click listener: for <a> whose href attribute starts with '#', preventDefault and set location.hash (same-document fragment nav on about:srcdoc: scroll, :target and hashchange all work). Skips defaultPrevented clicks and modifier keys. Follow-up: Cloudflare served /claude-runtime.js with max-age=14400, so browsers kept the old runtime for hours after deploy. The injected URL now carries ?v=<sha256 of the file> (next.config env RUNTIME_VERSION); versioned URL is immutable, bare URL no-cache. Follow-up 2: in the user's Zen, assigning location.hash made the frame try to load about:srcdoc#… and show an error page. That didn't reproduce in a clean headless Zen 1.23.4b profile, so the cause is profile-specific. The runtime now uses history.pushState(state, '', 'about:srcdoc#…'), which never loads anything, plus a synthetic hashchange and a manual scroll. It falls back to location.hash only where pushState throws (Playwright's Firefox)
